name: Forced displacement
summary: Fighting displaces 51,000+ in Sudan's Blue Nile; UNHCR says 64,000 fled Nigeria for Niger; no event over 500,000 a month
state: Local groups said more than 51,000 people had been newly displaced within Sudan's Blue Nile state, and IOM recorded several thousand more fleeing around Abu Zabad in West Kordofan (Darfur24, 23 Nov). UNHCR said nearly 64,000 people had fled insecurity in Nigeria for Niger (UN News). IOM put displacement in western Yemen above 340,000 over several months. None amounts to a new event displacing 500,000 people in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: New displacement is concentrated in Sudan's Blue Nile and Kordofan, northern Nigeria and western Yemen. Host areas there face pressure on shelter, water and food.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month found in UN or IOM figures
